source.title: Loon / Diver call 3
source.author: nicStage
source.notes: 96 kHz 24-bit stereo (Rode NT-4 into a Sound Devices MixPre-6), Mercer Lake, WI, 101 s: five wails of 3-4 s at 650-940 Hz (1.7-37.5 s), then 50 s of tremolo and yodel calling at 1.1-1.8 kHz, 35-49 dB over a quiet background with some rumble below 100 Hz. Chosen over his 'Loon / Diver call 1' (432605), the same calls over a background 23 dB louder. The tremolo phrases (62.5-74.9 s) were tried and left out.
